user.title: Connect to Valetudo
user.description: Valetudo itself speaks plain HTTP (e.g. http://192.168.1.50). A username and password are then sent unencrypted within your network.

certificate.title: Certificate not trusted
certificate.description: The TLS certificate of {url} could not be verified, for example because it is self-signed. Submit to connect without certificate verification, or close this dialog to cancel.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Valetudo
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the current one. Clear the username to connect without authentication.

error.invalid_auth: The username or password was rejected.
error.not_supported: This robot does not support Valetudo duststreaming.
error.streaming_disabled: Enable duststreaming in the Valetudo interface first.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this robot is already in progress.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This URL belongs to a different robot.
abort.reauth_entry_not_found: The existing configuration could not be found.
